description: This file defines an abstract class 'TimesheetPeriod' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Time\TimeSheetPeriod'. It serves as a base class for handling timesheet periods, declaring two abstract methods: 'setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate' and 'calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod'.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriod
classes.description: An abstract class representing a timesheet period with methods to set the period and calculate days within it.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Abstract method to set the timesheet period based on a start day.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate days within the period given the current date and XML data.
